title: Leorio Dangles a Faker Over a Cliff to Prove He's Faking

cuts.raw_narration: Down in the arena, the massive blue-skinned prisoner Majitani lies motionless on the stone floor, supposedly knocked out. Leorio, the tall man in a suit and small round sunglasses, has bet that the guy is only faking it. When the hooded prisoner Leroute asks how he plans to prove it, Leorio grins and says it's simple, really — he'll just push him off the edge. Kurapika calls it the worst idea he has ever heard, but Leorio doesn't flinch. He strides over to Majitani's body, crouches down, grabs him, and hoists the huge man up onto his shoulders like it's nothing, walking him toward the drop-off with a cool, confident smirk.

At the edge of the platform, Leorio props Majitani up by the shoulder and holds him out over the dark abyss. The camera cuts to close-ups of Leorio looking down over his shades, calm and cocky, while Majitani's stitched blue face starts sweating in panic even though he's supposed to be unconscious. Gon, Killua and Kurapika watch tensely from the side, and the hooded Leroute studies the scene from under her hood — she can see the sweat too.

Reading the same tell, Leroute quickly changes her bet: forty hours — everything she has left — that he isn't unconscious after all. Leorio smirks harder. Little sneak, he mutters, finally showing your true colors. Majitani, still refusing to break character, keeps his eyes squeezed shut as sweat pours down his face, dangling over nothing.

Then Leorio decides to force the issue. Guess I'll let go then, he says flatly — and opens his hand. Majitani drops. His eyes fly open mid-fall, he screams, and his blue arm shoots up, clawing for Leorio's sleeve and begging him to catch him. At the last second Leorio's hand snaps down and locks around his wrist, catching him one-handed over the pit. Leorio leans over the edge, looks his dangling, terrified prisoner dead in the eye, and calmly says: Good morning.

Leorio hauls him back up. The 'unconscious' Majitani immediately bolts across the platform, calls them all lunatics, and drops to the floor cowering — forget reducing my sentence, he says, I'm going back to prison where it's safe. As he sits there in defeat, Kurapika asks Leorio how he knew the guy was faking. Believe it or not, Leorio answers with a shrug — the way his eyes were moving was a dead giveaway.
